coverage_notes: I ran one query per firm or topic, in the priority order given. Most firm+'Duke University' queries were swamped by Duke Capital Partners and Duke Energy results and surfaced no Duke-alumni partners. That means no hit, not confirmed non-Duke. Firms with no hit: Commerce Ventures, Clocktower Technology Ventures, Better Tomorrow Ventures, Flourish Ventures, Portage Ventures, Citi Ventures, QED Investors, Nyca Partners, Theory Ventures, Zetta Venture Partners, Electric Capital, Variant, Galaxy (Digital) Ventures, Framework Ventures, Jump Capital, and the Citadel/Millennium-alumni-angel query. The generic AI-infra and fintech GP queries only returned already-found names (Lori Cashman, Logan Allin, Bill Quintenz). Only one new Duke-verified investor turned up: Ashwin Ramachandran (Dragonfly GP, Duke CS). His grad year is unconfirmed and may fall just after the 2018 cutoff. WebFetch to entrepreneurship.duke.edu is blocked by the egress proxy. Anthemis question answered: Kate Sampson is NOT a Duke alum (UMass Amherst). The Duke Pratt FinTech Master's advisory board (masters.pratt.duke.edu/fintech/advisory-board/) lists fintech investors, but board membership does not imply a Duke degree.

coverage_notes:
I used all 27 searches. One query each for Greycroft, First Round, Bain Capital Ventures, Floodgate, Foundation Capital, Mayfield, Madrona, Unusual, Craft, Ribbit, True, Spark, Lerer Hippeau, RRE and Boldstart, plus the open leads (BlueRidge, Suzanne Ashman, Squire Servance, Duke Capital Partners and Brooklyn Bridge). Some went to follow-up checks on individuals.

New Duke candidates: Matt McIlwain (Madrona), Nikhil Mittal (BlueRidge, Fuqua MBA, year unknown) and Squire Servance (Syridex Bio, Duke JD/MBA 2008).

Greycroft is still unresolved. theorg.com is blocked by the proxy, and the greycroft.com search found no Duke mention. Ian Sigalow and Dylan Pearce are ruled out.

Results by firm:
- Ribbit: Duke's Employees' Retirement Plan is a limited partner only, not a person.
- Duke Capital Partners: the search surfaced only Dave Neal as Venture Partner. No other venture partners were found.
- Lerer Hippeau, Unusual, Craft, Foundation Capital, Floodgate and Spark: no Duke-linked partner surfaced. Generic '"Duke University"' queries mostly return Duke Capital Partners pages, so these firms are not conclusively cleared.
